result.title: Automatic Differentiation with Constraints in Forward and Inverse Problems
result.summary: Approximate solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) on unstructured grids can be represented on a graph. Numerical optimization involving stiff evolutionary and static PDEs often requires solving a large system of equations, which can be treated as a constraint. In this work, we present a fully differentiable graph-based implicit solver that incorporates this constraint. We evaluate its performance across four key tasks: a) linear and nonlinear forward modeling of evolutionary and static problems, b) solving inverse problems to estimate equation coefficients, c) solving inverse problems to estimate the right-hand side, and d) learnable graph coarsening to accelerate forward modeling. The stability and differentiability of our solver enable significant reductions in the complexity of forward modeling while efficiently addressing related inverse problems. These capabilities make it a powerful tool for different physics and engineering applications, in particular for geophysics, where inverse problems are commonly solved in order to reduce the model uncertainty.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种基于图表示、可完全微分的隐式求解器，将刚性PDE的大规模方程组作为约束处理，并在正演建模、两类反问题与可学习图粗化四类任务上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其隐式约束求解与通过反问题求梯度/系数的思路，可能为LVR中「预测式工作区」的状态更新与限制条件、以及latent状态的训练监督提供方法线索，需核查可微隐式层的稳定性与计算成本。
